detail.title: Predictive Processing in Musical Cognition
detail.summary: Music engagement can be modeled through the lens of curiosity-driven learning, where rhythm and harmonic structure function as stimuli that modulate the brain's predictive error-correction mechanisms.
detail.reason: This update synthesizes the allowed curiosity-learning evidence with the project's music-cognition research goal, providing a theoretical bridge.

detail.title: Why Music Feels Like a Conversation with Uncertainty
detail.lede: Music might be more than just art; it could be a workout for our brain's prediction systems.
detail.reason: This post explains the shift in thinking—connecting AI learning theory to music appreciation—which is a meaningful, novel synthesis for an outsider.
